desc: 中文 AI 套话密集

inputs.text: 在当今数字化转型的浪潮中，企业必须 leveraging 云计算、大数据和人工智能等 robust 技术，才能 streamline 业务流程并提升核心竞争力。

result: 现在做企业，云计算、大数据、人工智能这些技术不用起来，基本就跟不上趟。关键是怎么把它们真正在业务里用起来，流程顺了，竞争力自然就上去了。

inputs.text: 一般来说，通常情况下，用户在使用这款产品时可能会发现，它的界面设计比较友好，功能也较为丰富。

result: 用这款产品的时候，你会发现界面挺顺手，功能也不少。

inputs.text: 值得一提的是，我们的产品具有三大优势：第一，操作简单；第二，功能强大；第三，性价比高。综上所述，它是您的最佳选择。

result: 我们这款产品有三个明显的优点：用起来很顺手，功能也够全，还特别划算。挑来挑去，选它准没错。

desc: 英文 AI clichés 密集

inputs.text: In today's fast-paced digital landscape, it is crucial to leverage robust AI solutions to streamline workflows and foster innovation. It is worth noting that comprehensive adoption can significantly improve outcomes.

result: If you’re working in tech right now, using smart AI tools isn’t just helpful—it’s pretty much a must if you want things to run smoothly and come up with new ideas. When you really commit to using them across the board, you’ll probably see a big difference.

inputs.text: Generally speaking, in many cases, users often find that this approach can potentially lead to somewhat better results, although it is important to note that outcomes may vary.

result: People sometimes find this approach gives better results, though your experience might be different.

inputs.text: Our platform offers three key benefits. First, it is user-friendly. Second, it is scalable. Third, it is cost-effective. In conclusion, we believe it is a pivotal solution.

result: You’ll find our platform easy to use, and it grows with you. Plus, it won’t break the bank. We think it could make a real difference.
